build_shard_tensor: build a function to shard a contiguous torch.Tensor according to a ChunkShardingSpec across distributed ranks
create_shard_parameter: create a function to shard a module parameter in-place by replacing it with a ShardedTensor
test_shard_module: test the shard_module function that shards all module parameters and hooks outputs per a ShardingPlan
refactor_load_with_process_group: refactor the load_with_process_group context manager to set the process group for loading a ShardedTensor
summarize_collect_local_shard: summarize the _collect_local_shard function that hooks a module to convert ShardedTensor output back to a local tensor
